title: Gare routière de l’Ouest shop tenants’ protest over municipal rents and closure
location: Gare routière de l’Ouest, Boulmiougou, Ouagadougou
scope: Local protest at one municipal bus-station market; no linked action elsewhere reported.
organizer: Shop tenants/managers; exact organizing body unknown. ONACOMBE official is quoted as spokesperson, not confirmed organizer.

state_target.target: Commune of Ouagadougou / agency responsible for municipal station (ADEU)
state_target.evidence: Kawtal says shopkeepers appealed to authorities managing the station; the commune says city-set rents and closure decision are at issue.

demands_original: Shop managers sought lower monthly rent (50,000 to 12,500 CFA) and appealed to station authorities.
participants_original: Kawtal describes shop managers in a peaceful movement but gives no number; the commune says some occupants among 56 shop lots initiated it.
threshold_50_evidence: No numeric attendance estimate. The 56 lots are not an attendance count; the commune says only some occupants. Threshold remains unresolved.

start_date.summary: The commune says the movement began Tuesday, 2 September 2025.

end_date.summary: Neither source states when protest activity ended; date unknown.

location.summary: Both identify Gare routière de l’Ouest, Ouagadougou; Kawtal says RN1.

scope.summary: Local action at one station; no other site reported.

organizer.summary: Shop managers/tenants participated; ONACOMBE secretary general is quoted but not identified as organizer.

state_target.summary: Demand targets local authorities managing a municipal station and city-set rents.

demands.summary: Both reports say shop tenants sought lower rents, proposing 12,500 CFA against 50,000 CFA.

participants_original.summary: No headcount; the commune says some occupants among 56 shop units.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No number establishes 50 simultaneous participants; unit count is not turnout.

protester_violence.summary: Kawtal calls it peaceful, but no independent account resolves violence.

state_response.summary: The commune issued a public clarification and explained temporary closure; no coded response outcome is established.

notes: Municipal policy rather than private labor negotiations; attendance and end date remain unknown. The city’s clarification is not itself evidence of a coded response outcome. Do not close the episode at month-end.
open_questions: How many participants were present simultaneously?
Did activity continue after 7 September; when did it end?
Was the commune statement a response to the movement or only communication of its closure decision?
